primary_paper.citation: Shang, C.; Zhang, X.-J.; Liu, Z.-P. Stochastic surface walking method for crystal structure and phase transition pathway prediction. Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 16 (2014), 17845-17856.

paper_facts.potential: V = 4 epsilon sum_{i<j}[(sigma/r)^12-(sigma/r)^6], epsilon=1, sigma=1 (reduced units).
paper_facts.boundary: periodic boundary conditions; random initial structure in a cubic cell
paper_facts.initialization: paper notes an initial cube with total volume based on 0.65 sigma particle radius; printed edges are 5.553 sigma for LJ128 and 11.107 sigma for LJ256; the precise random coordinate generator is not disclosed in the main text
paper_facts.reported_cell_density_consistency: The stated LJ128/LJ256 cell edges double when atom count doubles. If the same particle-volume density rule applies, edge should scale by 2^(1/3); printed lengths instead imply an eightfold volume increase for twofold N, or one-quarter number density. The paper report is internally inconsistent on this point; these lengths and density rule cannot be claimed as one exact shared-density protocol.

existing_same_pes_pilot.result: one joint-VC rutile step on MACE-OMAT-small/omat_pbe; 173 search E/F requests plus 2 fresh checks; accepted a lower enthalpy landing
existing_same_pes_pilot.qualification_boundary: Numerical joint-VC pilot only; not a matched atomic-only control and no phase identity assigned.

cases.proposed_contrast: paired common-start fixed-cell atomic escape + common full-cell quench versus five cell-direction cycles + the same atomic climb + the same full-cell quench; both arms execute an atomic climb on every outer step, so this isolates cell-cycle insertion and is not the paper lambda=2 schedule
cases.decision: Proceed only as a bounded development pilot after the frozen reference-quench gate; no MA or DFT pathway claim.

proposed_pilot.mechanistic_hypothesis: Cell degrees of freedom accessed during the escape stage can yield qualified basins unavailable from atomic-only escape with an identical posterior full-cell true quench.
arms: cell_off: fixed-cell atomic_climb on every outer step, followed by full cell_quench
cell_on: five fixed-cell-ion-relaxed cell_direction cycles, the same atomic_climb, followed by the same full cell_quench
held_equal: 12-atom rutile input after one common independently certified reference quench
atomic SSW configuration and per-step raw RNG state
300 K Metropolis formula and per-step draw
true-quench optimizer and physical stop criteria
proposed_pilot.design_boundary: Cell-on inserts cell cycles before every atomic climb so atomic and MC stages match. This tests cell-cycle insertion; it is not native behavior or the paper lambda=2 alternation schedule.

initial_gate.procedure: one same-PES full-cell true-quench qualification followed by an independent fresh E/F/stress call; stop before arm runs on failure
initial_gate.provenance: existing periodic SSW material protocol and physical cell stress certificate

proposed_pilot.budget_basis: older fixed-cell rutile runs used 388/438/432 requests over three outer steps and 173 requests for one joint-VC step; five extra cell cycles have unmeasured cost, so 6000 calls/arm is a hard ceiling intended to let the two requested escapes proceed, not an expected cost guarantee
proposed_pilot.primary_criterion: complete cell-quench-certified landing attempts and structural identity against the common start, with paired enthalpy, strain and cost summaries; report every failed/censored attempt
proposed_pilot.stop_rule: No outcome-dependent extension or retry. A request/wall cap before a complete outer escape is censored, not evidence the mechanism failed. No expansion if common reference qualification fails; completed one-seed pairs remain development evidence and cannot alone reject a general mechanism.
